# Mark Kenneth Telfer

**Role:** Son of Tim & Penny, husband of Kylie, father of Mitchell, Levi & Zabella
**Born:** 21 March 1986
**Birthplace:** Redcliffe, Queensland
**Residence:** Kippa-Ring, Queensland
**Education:** Mueller College, Rothwell QLD (graduated 2005)
**Occupation:** Speedy Towbars Australia (full-time) + Coles (part-time)

**Diagnoses:** Dyslexic, mixed anxiety/depressive disorder
**Stepmother:** [[Sheryle Telfer (1961–?)]]

## Life Summary

Mark Kenneth Telfer — son of Tim and Penny, stepson of Sheryle, husband to Kylie, father of three. Works full-time at Speedy Towbars and part-time at Coles. Christian, pro-life, married in the church. Faith is central.
